label: Model and codec directory
help: Prepare the pinned 24.1 GB model/codecs first. Runtime verifies local files and never downloads.

label: Inference Python executable
help: Dedicated Linux Python 3.12 with the pinned dependencies. Empty uses the app interpreter only if compatible; nothing installs automatically.

label: Spoken language
help: Auto or one of 31 languages declared by MOSS v1.5. Actual pronunciation quality depends on the model and input.

label: Optional voice reference
help: Optional finalized local clip: 0.5–30 seconds, at most 32 MiB. Without it the model selects a voice. Use only a voice you may reproduce.

label: Inference device
help: CUDA recommended; no silent CPU fallback. CPU requires float32 and substantial RAM. The model/codec load anew for each request.

label: Model precision
help: Bfloat16 on supported CUDA, or float32. The codec stays float32. CPU plus bfloat16 is refused explicitly.

label: Completed file format
help: Complete Ogg/Opus at 48 kHz or PCM WAV at 24 kHz. No direct live stream port.

label: Completed audio directory
help: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique names, no overwrites or automatic deletion.

label: Target duration (seconds; 0 = automatic)
help: Optional duration conditioning, not an exact-length guarantee. Use 0 or 0.08 seconds up to the maximum audio duration.

label: Maximum audio duration (seconds)
help: Reject the entire result above this limit, including all audio regions. Never crop and label incomplete speech complete.

label: Maximum text characters
help: Reject oversized text. The combined text and reference tokens must also fit the model’s context window.

label: Maximum generation steps
help: Budget for combined text/audio autoregressive steps. Both audio end and assistant EOS must be present; exhaustion publishes nothing.

label: Maximum audio regions
help: Allow multiple complete audio regions. They are decoded separately in order; no region is silently discarded.

label: Text-channel temperature
help: Official text-channel sampling temperature. Zero selects greedy decoding; not a voice or emotion selector.

label: Text-channel top-p
help: Official text-channel nucleus-sampling probability.

label: Text-channel top-k
help: Candidate text-token count. Zero disables this filter.

label: Audio-channel temperature
help: Official audio-code sampling temperature. Zero selects greedy decoding.

label: Audio-channel top-p
help: Official audio-code nucleus-sampling probability.

label: Audio-channel top-k
help: Candidate audio-code count. Zero disables this filter.

label: Audio repetition penalty
help: Official audio-token repetition control. Default 1; not a guarantee against repeated words.

label: CPU threads
help: Bound native CPU parallelism in the owned inference process.

label: Total request deadline (seconds)
help: Includes verification, loading, inference, encoding and publication. Maximum 240 seconds for managed execution.

label: Process address-space limit (MiB)
help: Optional Linux virtual-address ceiling: 0 disables it, otherwise at least 4096 MiB. CUDA reserves large virtual ranges. Not a RAM reservation.

label: Required available RAM (MiB)
help: Default 32 GiB. CPU also requires float32 weights plus a margin; CUDA checks free VRAM. These checks do not reserve memory.

label: Pending request limit
help: Active Runtime only. Zero rejects new text while busy. Interrupt stops the current job and clears earlier pending requests.
